note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk whole (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh). The mirror carries no Old Testament, so OT quotations reuse the wording of an already-shipped Amharic work where one quotes the same verse (source_file names it) and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register.

A `mined` row was re-measured against the finished text: an exact byte substring of at least 20 characters of the 1962 NT verse (or 25 of the cited corpus file) inside that block. Shorter or re-personed quotations are self_rendered, whatever the translator believed. The mirror bridges some verse ranges into one entry holding only part of their text (e.g. John 5:41-43, Revelation 4:9-11, Ephesians 3:8-10), so verses inside those ranges could not be quoted verbatim and are self_rendered.
